header.title: How to Clean the Filter in a Dishwasher
header.description: This guide provides simple steps to effectively clean your dishwasher filter, removing debris and sanitizing to maintain optimal performance. Learn how to locate, remove, and clean the filter using common household ingredients.

steps.description: Begin by ensuring the dishwasher is empty and removing the bottom rack to access the filter.
Clean around the filter area and remove any debris, potentially unscrewing and removing a closed filter.
actions: Clean around the area with a damp cloth
Unscrew the filter (if dishwasher has a closed filter)
Remove the debris located inside (if dishwasher has a closed filter)

steps.description: Sanitize the dishwasher by creating a cleaning mixture and running an empty cycle.
actions: Mix ½ cup of baking soda, ½ cup of salt and one cup of bleach.
Pour the mixture into the bottom of the dishwasher.
Allow the mixture to sit overnight.
Set the dishwasher to run a normal wash.
Ensure no dishes are in the dishwasher during the wash cycle.
